definitions.gloss: end of the mourning period; lifting of mourning
definitions.explanation: The day or time when the formal mourning period concludes, traditionally 49 days after a death in Buddhism (四十九日). After this point, one can resume normal social and celebratory activities.

examples.japanese: {忌明|きあ}け⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: The mourning period comes to an end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えて→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧{忌明|きあ}け⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The 49th day arrived and the mourning period ended.

examples.japanese: {忌明|きあ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{親戚|しんせき}→親戚：03260_shinseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まって→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: Family members gathered to hold a memorial service marking the end of the mourning period.

notes:
The mourning period ends after 49 days (⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧) in Buddhist tradition. On this day a memorial service is typically held.
